shop_1316.query: FROM sessions SHOW sessions, sessions_with_cart_additions, sessions_that_reached_checkout, sessions_that_completed_checkout WHERE hour_of_day >= 13 AND hour_of_day <= 16 GROUP BY day SINCE 2025-12-01 UNTIL 2026-11-13 ORDER BY day ASC LIMIT 400

shop_day.query: FROM sessions SHOW sessions, sessions_with_cart_additions, sessions_that_completed_checkout GROUP BY day SINCE 2026-03-01 UNTIL 2026-11-13 ORDER BY day ASC LIMIT 400

note: 11/13 19:4x取得。13〜16時台と終日を日別に（Shopify 2025/12〜・Meta 2026/3〜）。11/13 は 19時台の途中まで
